about.eyebrow: SG / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS
about.title: About Me
about.introduction: I'm Sakshi, an aspiring Data Scientist studying Information Technology at RGIPT. My interests span understanding data, finding patterns, and exploring what intelligent tools can do.
about.interestsDescription: Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence are the areas I want to explore through my studies and projects.
about.approachTitle: From a question to something useful.

approach.title: Start with the question
approach.text: My aim is to make the problem understandable before getting into tools or models. What are we trying to learn, and why would the answer matter?

approach.title: Look closely at the evidence
approach.text: Preparing data, checking it, and exploring patterns are part of the work that interests me. A useful explanation also makes room for what the data cannot tell us.

approach.title: Make the work understandable
approach.text: I want to connect technical work with clear summaries and visual explanations, so someone can follow the idea without needing to read the code.

about.learningDescription: I see projects and problem solving as ways to put ideas into practice. My next step is to keep developing my skills across analysis, machine learning, and AI while making the work easier to explain.

education.title: Education
education.introduction: An Information Technology degree, with a growing focus on data and intelligent systems.
education.interestsDescription: These are my career and technical interests; they are not a list of completed courses.
